purpose: Predeclared production-Ensemble participation policy after frozen ISB parity. Automatic runtime gates remain mandatory and this file cannot override a failed gate.

moments.evidence: Exact frozen grid, fitted-parameter, optimized, peptide/protein MS2Rescore, and target-only refit parity.

mle.evidence: Exact frozen grid, fitted-parameter, optimized, MS2Rescore, and target-only refit parity.

msfdr1_smix.evidence: Rank-1-only fitted parameters, MS2Rescore, and target-only refit parity passed exactly.

lower_order.reason: refit_with_locked_window passed exact parity, but reuse_dataset_artifact produced 6479/291/17 Level-4 PSM/peptide/protein counts instead of 558/44/10 and is not transfer-stable

msfdr.reason: unannotated grid and fitted state matched exactly, but regenerated macOS MS2PIP/DeepLC annotations caused downstream counts to exceed the frozen Linux platform tolerance

msfdr2_smix.reason: unannotated grid and fitted state matched exactly, but regenerated macOS MS2PIP/DeepLC annotations caused downstream counts to exceed the frozen Linux platform tolerance

nokoi.reason: the v1 artifact lacks fold-specific models, a reproducible fold-membership rule, explicit training rules, complete Grenander state, and source hashes; frozen fit, selected-window, and target-only parity also failed

mandatory_runtime_gates: dataset-local artifact provenance and strict search fingerprint
portable fitted-artifact schema and model-version validation
declared frozen parity within the configured tolerance
gate-layer entrapment FDP at or below the configured threshold
target-only transfer loss within the configured limit

ensemble_semantics.window_selection: Each expert keeps its independently optimized dataset-local window; no combined Ensemble window is optimized.
ensemble_semantics.insufficient_experts: Write an evaluable=false Ensemble lock with reasons and skip Ensemble stages without invalidating completed individual-model stages.
ensemble_semantics.invalid_evidence: Record the expert as rejected; do not abort the core workflow or silently admit the expert.

pxd_scope: No additional PXD001468 model run is required for Phase 8; PXD Moments is the sole required PXD parity model for this refactor.
